description: A Hyperliquid trader's current open positions: coin, side, sizeUsd, entryPx, markPx, leverage, pnl (unrealized), liquidationPx, openedAt or openedBefore. Use it before choosing a suggested trader: the Monthly Report figures are month-end and a trader can hold a large losing position now. Positions already open when you start copying are never copied; notCopied: true would mark a market WakeTrades does not copy. Also orders: the trader's open orders (kind limit, sl or tp; coin, side, reduceOnly, wholePosition, value, px = trigger price for sl / tp, tp and sl = trigger prices of the take profit and stop loss attached to that order or null, placedAt), to see the prices they are waiting for. Read from Hyperliquid, kept 60 seconds.
name: get_leader_positions
title: A trader's open positions now
